processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Sound portion of the 30 kg vacuum induction melted ingot was homogenized at 1423 K for 2.5 h.
Hot rolled at 1323 K; this condition is referred to as HR; final thickness of hot rolled plate was about 13 mm; details reported elsewhere [21].
Samples cut from hot rolled plates were cold rolled to ~50% reduction in thickness (~6 mm thick sheets) by subjecting to several passes at room temperature; samples after cold rolling denoted HR+CR.

Cold rolled sheets were heat treated in the temperature range 873 K–1273 K for 1 h followed by water quenching; samples referred to by the heat treatment temperature. The 873 K condition is documented for hardness only.

structures.overall_structure: Single-phase austenitic (γ) low-density steel; the Ni-free 28Mn0Ni alloy exhibits a single-phase austenite microstructure (B2-free) both in the hot rolled condition and after cold rolling. In HR+CR condition the austenite grains deformed mostly by planar slip, reflected by parallel slip bands; no traces of deformation twinning or martensite transformation were found.

phases_present.morphology: equiaxed γ-matrix in HR condition; deformed with parallel planar slip bands after cold rolling
phases_present.texture: nearly random texture in HR condition

defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: Irrespective of alloy content, the austenite grains deformed mostly by planar slip, as reflected by parallel slip bands (marked by an arrow in Fig. 1b for 28Mn0Ni); no deformation twinning and no martensite transformation in any cold rolled alloy.

interfaces.slip_behavior: Planar slip evidenced by parallel slip bands in austenite during cold rolling (up to 50%); no deformation twinning or martensite transformation.
interfaces.phase_evolution: No second phase present in 28Mn0Ni in HR or HR+CR condition (single-phase austenite); no B2 phase detectable by EBSD.
interfaces.interface_notes: As a single-phase austenite alloy, 28Mn0Ni has no prior γ/B2 interfaces at this condition; the 873 K heat-treated state was documented for hardness only and not microstructurally characterized.

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Bulk Vickers hardness measured on sample after 50% cold rolling + heat treatment at 873 K for 1 h followed by water quenching; AFFRI Vickers hardness tester, peak load 30 kg (~300 N), dwell time 15 s; value averaged over ten measurements

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: Vickers hardness after 50% cold rolling + heat treatment at 873 K: Ni-containing alloys were increased to 500 VHN, while there was no noticeable change in hardness of the Ni-free 28Mn0Ni alloy (remains ~450 VHN)

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Peak load 30 kg (~300 N), dwell time 15 s, per ASTM E-140-02; values averaged over ten measurements on each sample
characterization_methods.purpose: Evaluate the change in mechanical properties (hardness) of the chosen alloys upon cold working and heat treatment, including the 873 K condition.
characterization_methods.key_findings: Upon heat treatment at 873 K there was no noticeable change in hardness of the Ni-free 28Mn0Ni alloy (remains ~450 VHN), unlike the Ni-containing alloys which increased to 500 VHN.

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Zeiss Supra 55 FEG-SEM equipped with EDS and Nordley EBSD detectors (Oxford); TSL-OIM software; step size 120 nm/250 nm on ~100×100 μm² and ~200×200 μm² areas; colloidal silica ~100 nm polish
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Three scans per sample; KAM for strain localization and GOS 2° criterion for recrystallized microstructure; grain size by linear intercept; twin fraction via CSL Σ3 boundaries
characterization_methods.purpose: Determine grain orientations, grain size, twin fractions, phase contrast, strain localization and extent of recrystallization.
characterization_methods.key_findings: 28Mn0Ni in HR+CR is single-phase austenite (uniformly FCC) with planar slip bands; no B2 resolvable.

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Rigaku XRD instrument with Co-Kα radiation at 45 kV and 135 mA, beam size ~2 mm
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: XRD on selected samples to identify phases
characterization_methods.purpose: Identify phases (γ, B2, κ-carbide) present in cold rolled and heat-treated conditions.
characterization_methods.key_findings: 28Mn0Ni in HR+CR showed only γ-phase peaks.

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: FEI TECNAI 20T G2 operated at 200 kV equipped with EDAX EDS; twin-jet electropolished specimens in mixed acid at 243 K (-30 °C)
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Bright-field and dark-field imaging; SADP; dark-field from (010)κ satellite spot
characterization_methods.purpose: Identify phases and fine microstructural features not resolvable at SEM-EBSD scale; study post-tensile dislocation substructures.
characterization_methods.key_findings: At 1173 K the 28Mn0Ni alloy was essentially precipitate-free; fully recrystallized austenite deforms by planar slip and dynamic slip-band refinement.

unmapped_findings: The 873 K heat-treated condition of 28Mn0Ni is documented in the paper for hardness only; no XRD, TEM or EBSD microstructural characterization and no tensile data are reported for this specific 873 K condition.
Initial bulk Vickers hardness of 28Mn0Ni in the hot rolled (HR) condition was ~256 ± 5 VHN (b0045).
At 50% cold reduction the hardness of all three alloys saturated to ~450 VHN; the 15Mn5Ni alloy was ~20 VHN higher than 28Mn0Ni at 50% cold reduction (b0045).

All three alloys in HR+CR condition exhibited yield stress (0.2% offset) of 1.35–1.67 GPa and tensile strengths of 1.5–1.8 GPa with limited elongations of 6–11%; for 28Mn0Ni specifically HR+CR gave YS 1350 ± 10 MPa, UTS 1500 ± 10 MPa, TE 10 ± 0.4% (b0051, b0060) — but these belong to the HR+CR condition, not the 873 K condition.

The 28Mn0Ni alloy attained a maximum tensile elongation to failure of ~86% in the fully recrystallized and grain-growth condition (HR+CR+1173 K), which is outside the 873 K condition of this sample (b0051, b0060).
